hypotheses_rejected: The 55 full-suite failures observed before the first commit were a semantic regression from the migration. -> REJECTED: Root cause is tests/commander_lab/tools/service.py tracked_worktree_dirty, computed from `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no`. The uncommitted migration edits made the tracked worktree dirty, which those tests treat as stale canonical inputs. The same run on a clean worktree at the same head yields only the 6 pre-existing failures. Reproduced and then re-confirmed after a second dirty run post-merge.

A caller could select a non-max native variant, since `opencode run --variant high` was not rejected by the raw CLI. -> REJECTED: That probe deliberately bypassed the launcher. The launcher's validate_child_options refuses --variant in both `--variant X` and `--variant=X` spellings, and the injected bundle enables only the max variant. Verified directly: all four caller-flag spellings raise 'model/variant/continue child flags are launcher-controlled'.

Retiring the legacy Zen provider override should delete the flag so it is unrecognized. -> REJECTED: parse_known_args would forward an unrecognized --execution-provider into the child argv instead of failing. Keeping the flag as an always-refused tombstone fails closed and is directly testable.

technical_decisions.decision: Retire the legacy `--execution-provider zen` override entirely rather than keep it working.
technical_decisions.rationale: It resolved to opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free, a Muse identity. Keeping it reachable would violate MUSE_ACTIVE = NO.
technical_decisions.evidence: The flag is retained as an always-refused tombstone so parse_known_args cannot forward it to the child argv.

technical_decisions.decision: Integrate DeepSeek generically via one PROFILE_MODELS table rather than adding a third conditional branch.
technical_decisions.rationale: Both reachable executors are on opencode-go at native max, so executor identity is data. A future profile is one row plus one whitelist row.
technical_decisions.evidence: build_content_bundle now has a single unconditional pin block driven by execution['profile'].

technical_decisions.decision: Model and small_model are both deepseek-v4.1-flash.
technical_decisions.rationale: Internal consistency of main/small/default configuration, matching the prior contract where model equalled small_model. Per-profile runs pin small_model to the selected executor.

technical_decisions.decision: Preserve docs/project_integrity_20260928/OWNERSHIP_DEFERRALS.json byte-identical and add an additive resolution record instead of editing the historical file.
technical_decisions.rationale: The deferral is true dated provenance that the operator's own prior authority created. Superseding it by the same operator does not license rewriting history; it licenses recording the supersession.

technical_decisions.decision: Repair main's added test_nested_muse_launch_clears_ambient_native_variant by migrating its intent rather than deleting it.
technical_decisions.rationale: The hardening is valuable and current; only the Muse profile it selected is retired. Under the new policy every profile pins max, so the enforceable property becomes per-profile overwrite of an ambient identity, which is strictly stronger than absence.
technical_decisions.evidence: test_nested_launch_overwrites_ambient_native_variant seeded with the retired xhigh level
